question: #12457: does a SegmentedControl segment grow with its label at 200% text, on every theme, at 1280 and 390, in light and dark?

method.themes: no theme global (Storybook default, Neutral tokens, fonts as served), neutral, stone, butter, chocolate, gothic, matcha, y2k; each theme's own body face injected from its fonts.css
method.textSize: 100% and 200% root font size (element sizes are px; text sizes are rem)
method.modes: Storybook global colorMode and the page color scheme, light and dark
method.settle: network idle, fonts loaded and ready, two animation frames, 250 ms; reduced motion; screenshots with animations finished and the caret hidden
method.textBox: a DOM Range over the segment title: its glyph area
method.lineBox: the segment title element: its line box
method.stills: the radiogroups and their titles with a 12 px margin, 200% text, size-variants and with-icons

phonePresetCheck.why: The changeset says Neutral's small phone segment grows from 20 to 21 px at the default text size. This check uses the repository's own Playwright phone preset.
